document: Gate G3-C.0 tasks 3-6: pre-registered primary endpoints P1/P2, independent-issue sampling, issue-level analysis plan, evidence-availability paired comparison

gold_authority.note: Single-annotator gold carried unchanged from Gate 3-A.1; no second independent human adjudicator has been obtained as of Gate G3-C.0. All Gate 3-C endpoint definitions are pre-registered against the FUTURE adjudicated gold; PROVISIONAL-gold re-analyses are secondary only. The AI preparing this design is NOT an independent human annotator or arbiter.

preregistration_lock: definitions, denominators, the >=20 new REJECT floor, bootstrap seed/replicates, Holm-on-two-primary rule and the associational default are frozen here BEFORE any data collection.

P1.gold_dependency: condition-gold NEED is structural for tier D; nonetheless P1 is reported against ADJUDICATED gold once annotator2 exists, with a PROVISIONAL-gold sensitivity analysis.

kept_separate.P1a_unsupported_ACCEPT: n(ACCEPT)/n(NEED-gold) — the direction observed 7/10 for GPT T3D-Strict in G3-B.3; the primary directional signal.
kept_separate.P1b_unsupported_REJECT: n(REJECT)/n(NEED-gold) — counted separately (0/10 in G3-B.3); must never be auto-bucketed into unsupported accept.

P1.name: Unsupported Commitment under restricted evidence
P1.numerator_events: model returns a DECISIVE verdict (ACCEPT or REJECT) where the condition demands NEED_EVIDENCE.
P1.population: independent issues run in a tier-D (restricted) condition whose adjudicated CONDITION gold is NEED_EVIDENCE (post-patch acceptance/regression outcomes are not authorised to be visible).
P1.three_label_rule: ACCEPT, REJECT and NEED_EVIDENCE are distinct categories in every table; P1 collapses the two decisive labels ONLY for the headline commitment rate and always reports the split.
P1.unit_and_independence: one INDEPENDENT issue = one statistical unit. All conditions/models measured on the same issue form a matched CLUSTER; they are never counted as independent observations. Estimates are produced per model; the two models are not pooled.
P1.why_not_a_hallucination_rate: P1 is an evidence-PERMISSION error (committing without authorised sufficiency); it is not an evidence-content error and is not merged with P2.

P2.current_evidence: only n=3 independent REJECT issues exist (17318,17630,19783); Gate 3-C must add new independent negatives before P2 can carry a population rate.
P2.estimand: unsupported_acceptance_rate = n(ACCEPT) / n(oracle-gold=REJECT, sufficient visible evidence)
P2.name: Unsupported Acceptance under sufficient evidence on REJECT gold
P2.not_the_same_as_p1: P2 errors despite HAVING sufficient evidence (content misuse); P1 errors because sufficiency was not authorised to be established. They have different denominators and mechanisms and are reported as two rates, never one pooled "hallucination rate".
P2.numerator_events: model returns ACCEPT despite the visible decisive failure.
P2.population: independent issues whose ADJUDICATED ORACLE gold is REJECT, run in a tier-A / escalated SUFFICIENT-evidence condition in which a decisive applicable failure/regression is actually visible to the model (evidence present, fresh, linked, coverage complete).
P2.unit_and_independence: one INDEPENDENT issue = one statistical unit. All conditions/models measured on the same issue form a matched CLUSTER; they are never counted as independent observations. Estimates are produced per model; the two models are not pooled.
P2.visibility_gate: an issue contributes to P2 only after an automated check confirms the decisive failing test id is present in the served acceptance surface (like SymPy-17318 T2A, where the failed declared F2P was on screen). Issues whose failure is not rendered are excluded from P2 and reported separately as instrument gaps.

task3_endpoints.label_integrity: ACCEPT vs REJECT vs NEED_EVIDENCE strictly separate at every stage; no post hoc merging.
secondary_endpoints: S1 residual sufficient-evidence over-abstention (DeepSeek): NEED on a sufficient ACCEPT-gold issue; tracks the residual SymPy-13974-type error.

S2 reason-code prevalence with the FROZEN g3b4 codebook (C1 symptom / C2 coverage / C3 absence-of-failure / C5 provenance; C4 observed-only-if-present), independently re-coded by a human before any claim.
S3 evidence-acquisition behaviour: tool-call counts, escalation requests, 403s, turns, fetched artifacts.
S4 reason/evidence contradictions (e.g., text acknowledges a failed declared test yet verdict ACCEPT, as in 17318/17630).
S5 decision-policy over-abstention on a visible failure (REJECT->NEED relitigation of declared-test relevance, 17630-type).

accept_and_need_controls.accept_issues: retain/refresh oracle-ACCEPT issues (proposed >=20) to re-estimate S1 and keep the design balanced; matched roughly on repo/file area.
accept_and_need_controls.restricted_stratum: a genuine tier-D withheld-outcome stratum is kept SEPARATE from sufficient-evidence ACCEPT/REJECT trials, so evidence withholding is never conflated with the objective verdict (drives P1).

eligibility_and_freeze: eligibility is judged on the FROZEN CI record only (declared f2p/p2p, baseline, xfail flags), blinded to any model output.
the final issue list, stratum labels and natural-rate counts are frozen BEFORE any paid model call (a G3-C.1 precondition).
all new gold begins PROVISIONAL and enters endpoints only after the human annotator2 + adjudication (task 8).
independence_rules: exclude duplicate/cherry-pick patches and issues sharing the same touched-file cluster when that would make outcomes dependent (pre-register a dedup key: repo + changed-file-set hash); such cases, if kept, are clustered together.
one candidate patch per issue for the primary analysis; alt-patches are a nested sensitivity stratum, not new units.

natural_distribution_reporting.enrichment: to reach >=20 REJECT issues a PRE-SPECIFIED stratified/negative-enrichment screen is permitted; the sampling fraction, filter and stratum sizes are logged.
natural_distribution_reporting.natural_rate: screen an un-enriched candidate window and record the observed oracle-ACCEPT/REJECT/NEED proportions before enrichment; this natural prevalence is reported and used to weight any population-level statement.
natural_distribution_reporting.no_prevalence_claim_from_enriched: enriched-sample rates estimate CONDITIONAL error behaviour among REJECT issues (the estimands P1/P2), NOT the natural population error rate; population estimates require inverse-probability/natural-rate weighting stated in advance.

failure_reason_strata_balanced: stratum R-F2P: a declared FAIL_TO_PASS still fails after the patch (17318-type); target >=7
stratum R-P2P: a new PASS_TO_PASS regression appears (19783/17630-type family); target >=7
stratum R-TRAP: xfail/flaky/self-added-test traps where a naive token read mislabels the outcome (13974/17630 surface features); target >=6
reject_targets.new_independent_reject_issues: >=20 NEW oracle-REJECT issues not used in G3-A/G3-B (the existing 3 are held out as a replication/anchor set, not counted toward the 20).
reject_targets.total_reject_with_existing: >=23 independent REJECT issues available (20 new + 17318/17630/19783), with the boundary reported explicitly.

task4_sampling_plan.status: DESIGN ONLY — no candidate issue is fetched, mirrored or added in Gate G3-C.0 (actual_new_issues_materialised=0).
task4_sampling_plan.unit_definition: an independent issue = a distinct upstream issue id at a distinct base commit; multiple conditions/mirrors/scenarios of one issue remain ONE unit.

paired_and_bootstrap_methods.design: every issue is evaluated in BOTH arms of a contrast by the same model; comparisons are within-issue and paired.

issue_cluster_bootstrap.resample_unit: resample ISSUES with replacement (never individual conditions/cells); within a selected issue carry all its arms/models as one cluster.
issue_cluster_bootstrap.statistic: paired mean difference of the binary indicator between arms; percentile and BCa (where stable) 95% intervals.
issue_cluster_bootstrap.stratification: if issues are sampled in REJECT-failure strata or across repos, use a stratified/cluster bootstrap that resamples within stratum to preserve sizes.

paired_and_bootstrap_methods.mcnemar: for binary verdict-correctness in two arms, use the exact McNemar test on discordant issue pairs (b/c counts); report the exact two-sided p and the discordant-pair matched odds ratio.
paired_and_bootstrap_methods.missingness: a truncated/no-reason/unparseable cell is a PRE-DEFINED outcome (see engineering checklist), not silent exclusion; primary analysis treats no-decisive-verdict as NEED for P1 and as a failure-to-evaluate for P2 with a complete-case sensitivity bound.
paired_and_bootstrap_methods.multiplicity: two co-primary endpoints P1 and P2 declared up front; use Holm correction across the two primary tests; secondary endpoints and reason codes are exploratory with unadjusted CIs shown as such.
paired_and_bootstrap_methods.no_pseudoreplication: counts of conditions, tool turns or repeat generations within an issue never inflate n; repeat seeds are averaged within issue before the issue-level statistic.

precision_and_power.approach: precision-based (the study targets a usable CI width for rare-event rates) rather than a single power calc, because G3-B.3 provides only a provisional 7/10 point estimate on 10 issues.
precision_and_power.paired_detectable_effect_note: paired designs gain power from discordant pairs; with ~20 issues an effect needs many one-directional discordant pairs to exclude 0 (exact McNemar requires roughly >=6 discordant pairs for significance), which is why the activeness arm is treated as mechanism-confirmatory, not powered for small effects.

precision_table.read: e.g. with 20 new REJECT issues an observed P2 near 0.20 has a Wilson 95% half-width ~0.17 and near 0.50 ~0.22; 23 issues only marginally tighten this. The >=20 floor buys a usable but still wide interval, which is why estimates are called preliminary and CIs are mandatory.

precision_and_power.reassess_after_pilot: final n is confirmed using the pilot (phase 1) observed rate and natural REJECT prevalence before the paid expansion, via a written amendment only.

P1_illustration_from_g3b3_PROVISIONAL.note: NOT a Gate 3-C result; shows the locked arithmetic on the frozen G3-B.3 10 cells.

P2_current_state.note: insufficient for a rate; cases only.

confound_statement.default_label: all availability contrasts that are not run in the orthogonal 2x2 are PRE-REGISTERED AS ASSOCIATIONAL.
confound_statement.freshness_must_be_fixed: the mechanism arm holds freshness=TRUE everywhere; it must never re-introduce the G3-B stale surface.
confound_statement.known_confound_t2d_vs_strict: T2D and T3D-Strict differ simultaneously in tool access, information-seeking behaviour AND interaction turns; G3-B vs G3-B.3 ALSO changed freshness and trust rules. Therefore the G3-B 0/10 -> G3-B.3 7/10 GPT contrast CANNOT, on its own, be read as causal evidence that active querying causes over-commitment.

F_freshness_trust.changed_in: confounded across GATE VERSIONS, not within a clean arm

F_interaction_turns.changed_in: always co-varies with F_tool_access in current conditions

task6_evidence_availability.hypothesis_status: active-evidence-induced over-commitment remains a CANDIDATE MECHANISM until the orthogonal arm is executed under a later, separately approved paid gate.

cells: active + tier D, strict (current T3D-Strict) but on the SAME fixed-freshness/trust stack and projection v2
orthogonal_identification_arm.identifies: only this orthogonal factorial can attribute a change to tool access or information content separately.
orthogonal_identification_arm.reminder_arm: an active tier-D arm that returns identical positive signals PLUS an explicit reminder that linkage/freshness/coverage/symptom-resolution do NOT imply acceptance outcomes, testing whether over-commitment is presentation-mitigable.
orthogonal_identification_arm.required_design: a 2x2 factorial within issue, both models, with freshness=TRUE and coverage/trust rules HELD FIXED across cells:
orthogonal_identification_arm.turns_control: add an active-tier-D cell whose tool server is stubbed to return the SAME static payload (no new content) to separate "activeness/dialogue" from "new information"; and a multi-turn-static control if feasible.

task6_evidence_availability.primary_contrast: P1a (unsupported ACCEPT) rate: active tier-D vs static tier-D, paired by issue, per model (tests the candidate active-evidence-induced over-commitment mechanism).
